channel.title: starwire: the day's best
channel.description: One item a day: the open source repos rising fastest, and the biggest new picks

item.title: Nov 20: modern-web-guidance, kiri, rust-anything
item.description:
Rising fastest

  1. GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance (+14k a week, 23k stars): Current web best practices packaged as guidance for coding agents
  2. libracoder/kiri (+9.3k a week, 11k stars): Small, fast container runtime that runs on macOS, Windows and Linux
  3. erkamyaman/rust-anything (+5.3k a week, 5.3k stars): Agent skill that ports an app to Rust piece by piece with equivalence checks
  4. elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter (+7.0k a week, 13k stars): Claude Code skills for bug hunting and external red-team testing
  5. Tencent/LoopForge (+3.4k a week, 4.1k stars): Workflows that orchestrate coding agents with scripts and approval gates
